review.scope: All four in-process recommendations; not a full repository audit

changes.result: Application SettingsService owns source mutation, History invalidation and ActionRegistry publication. Bridge calls one use case; production-seam tests cover search, bindings, stale execution and rejected configuration.

SettingsController owns one close decision. SettingsEdits owns search/exclusion drafts and queued writes. Screen only presents the choice. Pending and already-finished failures follow the same prompt; save completion preserves newer edits.
Moved ObjectActionCoordinator to shared tools; Launcher and AppHistorySession share request ordering and stale results. Target guards and menu presentation remain local.
AppHistorySession owns rowExtent; Page rendering, page navigation and reveal use it. Tests render 52px and 80px rows.

additional_consistency_fix: Hidden-app draft comparison and persistence use one comma/newline parser, avoiding phantom unsaved drafts after successful save.

automated.native_close_mock_regressions: passed; includes pending failure timing, duplicate close requests, save/discard/cancel and edits during save
